From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: pricing & committed-use discussion (recap + ask)

Hi Maya - great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our call and a couple of requests so we can size the right committed-use option:

Recap:
- Primary use: in-product assistant (generation) + occasional batch embeddings for search + reranking for recommendations.
- Typical response lengths ~200-400 tokens (generation) per turn, embedding size standard 1536 dims.
- Target latency SLO: 200-400ms p50 for interactive flows.

Info we need to price/structure discounts:
1) Expected token consumption (monthly): a) generation tokens/month, b) embeddings vectors stored/calls per month. If you have an initial and 6/12 month ramp that helps.
2) Target budget range (monthly) and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs. annual committed-use).
3) Any startup program eligibility details (incorporation date, YC/accelerator? investor info) so we can confirm credits.

Rough next steps: once we have volumes + target $/month, I can run unit economics for a few committed-use tiers (e.g., 3m, 6m, 12m commits) and send a pricing sheet + draft SOW. If it looks good we can route to legal for a simple committed-use addendum and include startup credits where eligible.

Thanks - happy to hop on a quick follow if you want to walk numbers together.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Startup program: we were accepted into the Vertex Labs accelerator earlier this year (April 2027). Company incorporated 2025. We have a small bridge round closed. Happy to share incorporation docs if that helps.

1) Can you show example $/1M tokens at list vs. committed discounts (and how that maps to our ramp)?

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@appscale.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & committed-use discussion (recap + ask)

Thanks for the detail - this is perfect and lets me run some concrete unit economics. Below are three worked examples (rounded) showing list vs. committed tiers, expressed as $ per 1M tokens (generation + embeddings normalized to token-equivalent where applicable) and monthly totals for your ramp months.

Assumptions:
- List (hosted) gen price baseline: $4.00 per 1M tokens
- List embeddings baseline (vector generate only): $1.00 per 1M-token-equivalent
- We normalize everything into token-equivalent so it's easier to compare; final invoice separates generation vs embeddings.

Tiers (committed-use discounts on list):
- 3-month trial / small commit (no minimum): 10% off list
- 6-month committed tier (monthly commit >= $10k): 20% off list
- 12-month committed tier (monthly commit >= $20k): 30% off list
- Multi-year (2+ year) strategic: up to 40% with annual price lock and custom SLA

Example $/1M tokens (list vs tiers):
- List: $4.00 / 1M tokens
- 20% commit: $3.20 / 1M tokens
- 30% commit: $2.80 / 1M tokens
- 40% commit: $2.40 / 1M tokens

Applied to your ramp (generation only for simplicity):
- Month 1 (25M tokens):
  - List: 25 * $4.00 = $100
  - 20% commit: 25 * $3.20 = $80
  - 30% commit: 25 * $2.80 = $70

- Month 6 (100M tokens):
  - List: 100 * $4.00 = $400
  - 20% commit: 100 * $3.20 = $320
  - 30% commit: 100 * $2.80 = $280

- Month 12 (300M tokens):
  - List: 300 * $4.00 = $1,200
  - 20% commit: 300 * $3.20 = $960
  - 30% commit: 300 * $2.80 = $840

Notes on startup program stacking:
- Standard startup offer: $10k platform credit over 6 months (one-time).
- Credits apply to invoice dollars after discounts (i.e., credit reduces your net billed amount).
- We can combine the startup credit with a committed-use discount; the credit does not increase the percentage off but lowers your net spend in early months.

Proposal / next steps:
- I will attach a short pricing sheet and a draft SOW showing the 12-month committed-use option at a $20k/month commit (30% off) and how credits would apply to the first 6 months. That option looks like it would put you in the ~$20k/mo bracket by month 6 while keeping economics under your planned growth.
- If that looks good, we can route to legal for a simple committed-use addendum (no complex T&C changes).
- If you prefer to preserve optionality, we can start with a 3-month trial with a 10% commit and then convert.

Would you like me to send the pricing sheet + draft SOW now? I can also schedule a 20-min call with Marissa (customer success lead) to walk through the billing and onboarding timeline.

Thanks - will attach the docs in a follow-up.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
